claims.claim: The publisher projects at most one attention identity after successful source capture and artifact upload, then directly calls the existing reusable wake workflow without a downstream workflow_run dependency.

Direct and artifact-collected projection share project_source. The direct path checks the capture digest and binds current run, attempt and uploaded artifact selectors; added regressions assert identical event identities and exact pointer binding.

The bridge preserves projected failure and conflict outcomes despite publisher-job failure. Shared projection excludes ordinary progress, and malformed, unproven or multiple eligible identities fail closed.
The reusable handoff contains only event_id and the fixed trung-via/AIOS-renew repository identity, with no semantic instructions, execution profile, browser binding, logs or assistant output.

The bounded publication source artifact retains its 90-day contract. The changes introduce no actions-write permission, self-dispatch, repository dispatch, secret, Issue/comment bridge, polling mechanism or ChatGPT Work invocation.

Both source paths derive the same canonical identity and enter the existing durable lane. Added regression assertions cover duplicate NOOP and ambiguous no-resend behavior; no additional lane or queue is introduced.

Existing canonical review and publication checks remain authoritative. The handoff performs no roadmap mutation, and local wake freshness, targeting, generation, ambiguity and privacy guards remain unchanged.

The committed changes affect only the five authorized files. The conformance procedure requires reviewed publication of TASK-280 before rerunning the Human publication-success probe and leaves live conformance and H4B readiness unclaimed.
